audit.whatIsWrong: His sustain is attributed to 'axe lifesteal' throughout.
audit.why: Undertow is a thrown axe that reduces armour and slows — it has no lifesteal. The sustain is Berserker Rage (P), which grants attack speed and lifesteal scaling with his MISSING health, so a low Olaf heals harder, not less. That inverts the whole 'chip him down' plan.
audit.corrected: Berserker Rage gives more attack speed and lifesteal the lower he gets — chipping him into a fight makes him stronger, so burst or disengage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is described as stacking 'armor/MR pen'.
audit.why: Ragnarok passively grants Olaf bonus armour and magic resist and, when activated, makes him immune to disables while he keeps attacking. It grants no penetration at all, so 'pens through your passive shield' is doubly wrong. It is 100/90/80s.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok (100s at rank 1) gives him resists and disable immunity — he becomes unpeelable, not more penetrating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Reckless Swing's true damage and Undertow's cooldown reset are absent.
audit.why: Reckless Swing (E, 11/10/9/8/7s, 325 range) deals true damage at the cost of his own health and refunds it on a kill — no armour or shield item reads that trade. Undertow (Q, 9s, 1000 range) resets its cooldown the moment he picks the axe back up, so the real safe window is not nine seconds unless you stand between him and the axe.
audit.corrected: Reckless Swing is true damage on a 7-11s cooldown; Undertow refunds its cooldown on pickup, so deny the axe rather than counting to nine.

edits.before: His R (Ragnarok) makes him CC-immune and stacks armor/MR pen with lifesteal — your E swing can't peel a CC-immune Olaf and your passive shield gets chewed straight through, so never get walked into a wall.
edits.after: Ragnarok (100s) makes him immune to disables while he swings plus bonus armour and MR — your E can't peel a CC-immune Olaf and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores what you bought, so never get walked into a wall.

edits.before: Dodge his axe (Q) so the slow misses, then Q-poke and double-shot him while the axe is on cooldown
edits.after: Dodge Undertow so the slow and armour cut miss, then stand between Olaf and the axe so he can't reset it

edits.before: Sustain through your poke with axe lifesteal and outscale you into a durable teamfight bruiser
edits.after: Sustain through your poke — Berserker Rage's lifesteal grows as his health drops — and outscale you

edits.before: It is a coinflip — your Q and E chip him, but his axe lifesteal heals the poke right back, so neither side owns the window.
edits.after: It is a coinflip — your Q and E chip him, but Berserker Rage lifesteals harder the lower he gets, so chip alone never converts.

edits.before: His R (Ragnarok) makes him CC-immune and your E can't peel him, but your R (Comeuppance) still executes him from range, so the level cancels out.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables and your E can't peel him, but your R (Comeuppance) still executes him from range, so the level cancels out.

edits.before: Past two items he outscales your lethality — a durable Ragnarok bruiser who pens through your passive shield and walks down your poke.
edits.after: Past two items he outscales your lethality — a Ragnarok bruiser with bonus resists whose Reckless Swing true damage walks through your build.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are a coinflip — your Q poke and E mobility chip him, but his axe lifesteal heals it back, so neither of you cleanly owns the window. The pattern is simple: only commit when his axe is on cooldown, and never let him pin you against a wall. At 6 his R (Ragnarok) is the scary part — he becomes CC-immune with stacked armor/MR pen and lifesteal, so your E (Heroic Swing) can no longer peel him and his auto-attacks shred through your passive shield. Your R (Comeuppance) is a missing-health pick/execute, not a brawl button — use it to finish a low Olaf, not to start a fight under his Ragnarok.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are a coinflip — your Q poke and E mobility chip him, but Berserker Rage lifesteals harder the lower his health drops, so neither of you cleanly owns the window. The pattern is simple: commit only while Undertow is down and you stand between him and the axe, since picking it up resets the 9s cooldown outright. At 6 Ragnarok (100s) is the scary part — immune to disables while he keeps attacking, with bonus armour and MR on top, so Heroic Swing can no longer peel him and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores whatever you bought. Your R is a missing-health execute, not a brawl button.

edits.before: First item is your one clear lead window — a Youmuu's or Serpent's Fang lethality spike lets your Q and double-shot burst race his axe lifesteal if you catch him on cooldown, and Serpent's grievous wounds directly counters his sustain. Convert here, because past two items Olaf out-grows your lethality: he becomes a durable bruiser who walks through your poke, ults CC-immune, and pens straight through your passive shield. If the game stretches long he wins the straight 1v1, so use your camo W (Going Rogue) to roam and pressure the map while you still out-tempo him.
edits.after: First item is your one clear lead window — a Youmuu's or Serpent's Fang lethality spike lets your Q and double-shot burst race Berserker Rage's lifesteal if you fight while Undertow is down, and grievous wounds directly counters that sustain. Convert here, because past two items Olaf out-grows your lethality: a durable bruiser who walks through poke, ults immune to disables with bonus resists, and answers your shield with 325-range true damage. If the game stretches he wins the straight 1v1, so use Going Rogue to roam while you still out-tempo him.

notes: Two hard errors corrected: the lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with missing health, not the axe; and Ragnarok grants bonus armour and MR plus disable immunity, not 'armor/MR pen'. Reckless Swing's true damage was missing entirely and is the reason defensive itemisation reads this matchup wrong.
